description: Proposed landscape, habitat enhancement and community amenity improvements on the site and along the left bank of the adjoining River Crane.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([0091/080 - Planning Statement - P3], [30/05/2017 - Introduction and Existing - P1], [30/05/2017 - Proposal and Signage - P1], [0091/001 - Existing Site Key and Location Plan - P3], [0091/001.1 - Location Plan - P1], [0091/002 - Existing Site Analysis - 3D], [0091/003 - Site Setup and Phasing Plan - T2], [0091/004 - Site Safety and Evacuation Plan - Phases 1 + 2 - T2], [0091/004.1 - Site Safety and Evacuation Plan - Phases 3 + 4 - T2], [0091/005 - Existing Sections 1,2 - P2], [0091/006 - Existing Section 3,4 - P2], [0091/007 - Existing Sections 5, 6, 7 - P2], [0091/008 - Existing Sections 8, 9 - P2], [0091/009 - Existing Sections 10, 12 - P2], [08/01/2018 - Cain Bio-Engineering Topo/feature Survey], [14288_V2 - River Crane Site Visit Assessment - V2], [14288_102 - Existing River Features Plan], [14288_103 - River Photograph Location Plan], [PR14288_101- Crane_Hounslow_Topo Survey_FINAL], [PR14288_201 - Crane_Hounslow_Cross Sections_FINAL], [21/11/2017 - Site Survey Photographic Analysis], Received: 27/10/2020 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before any materials are removed from site and before construction vehicles enter the site for the first time, a Construction Logistics Plan that adheres to the latest TfL guidance shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details as approved shall be adhered to throughout the course of construction.

Condition : 4 - The work shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Excavation and Soil Strategy Statement (Doc ref. 0091/081) and the findings of the Phase 2 Intrusive Site Investigation submitted with the application hereby approved.
 
Levels of contamination shall be sampled and monitored throughout the soil movement phases of the project and if this reveals levels of contamination higher than previously predicted or identified, revised remediation measures shall be devised and submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before the affected part of the approved project is allowed to continue.
